about_the_game:
A combination of a rogue-like deckbuilder, an auto-battler and a turn based strategy game. Acquire cards, upgrade them, play them to influence the board and adventure through a world plagued by a mysterious affliction.

Fields of Malice combines a few different mechanics:

  • Auto Battler Style Shop: In Fields of Malice you don't draw cards the normal way, but instead buy them from a shop using gold which you gain every round. Get your hands on 3 of the same card to upgrade it up to 2 times!

  • Deckbuilding: Assemble your army by picking up cards along your journey. Create powerful synergies or patch up any weaknesses in your deck. Fields of Malice has over 300 cards from 7 different regions with their own playstyles to choose from!

  • Turn based strategic gameplay: Once you enter a battle you will use your cards to defeat the spawns of the Malice. Do so by placing units on the board and moving and attacking with them. Or use powerful spells to aid your allies or hinder your enemies.

Rogue-like elements: No two runs in Fields of Malice are the same! Come across different special encounters, strange puzzles and of course various different rewards for completing them.

Fields of Malice includes: (currently)

  • 300+ Cards across 7 different regions

  • 20+ Combat Encounters

  • 20+ Puzzle Encounters

  • 50+ Relics
